generator.note: Embeddings are baked ONCE with kmd-encode and committed. Motion generation then runs from the embedding alone (kmd-generate-embed), which loads only the 1.1 GB motion model and never the ~15 GB text bundle. Verified byte-identical to the text path at the same seed.

generationDefaults.note: CFG weights mirror kmd-generate's hardcoded generate_text(..., 2.F, 2.F). Changing them changes the output; they are pinned here so a rebake is reproducible.

prompts.text: a soldier stands alert holding a rifle, breathing steadily, making small idle adjustments
prompts.intent: base standing idle; the clip the player sees most and the one existing 24-clip set is thinnest on

prompts.text: a soldier crouches low holding a rifle and stays alert, shifting weight slightly
prompts.intent: crouched idle; pairs with the stance system

prompts.text: a soldier crouches and reloads a rifle
prompts.intent: reload while crouched - the canary that proved the model responds to stance (hip 0.372 m vs 1.006 m standing)

prompts.text: a person walks forward at a steady pace
prompts.intent: locomotion reference; first canary, travels 5.30 m on +Z

prompts.text: a person runs forward and vaults over a low obstacle, landing and continuing
prompts.intent: traversal the authored set has no coverage for

prompts.text: a person flinches backward sharply as if struck in the chest, then recovers stance
prompts.intent: damage feedback; complements the existing HitRecieve clips with a distinct read
